description.value: Days Inn Nanaimo is a 79-room mid-range hotel positioned midway between the Duke Point and Departure Bay Ferry Terminals, making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists arriving or leaving Vancouver Island by ferry. The property is one of the few hotels in Nanaimo with an indoor pool and hot tub, and it offers an on-site full-service restaurant (Ricky's All Day Grill) as well as a complimentary continental breakfast. Pet-friendly and kitchenette rooms are available, and the front desk is staffed around the clock.

address.value: 809 Island Highway South, Nanaimo, BC V9R 6Z2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms this is a real, operating 79-room hotel with detailed amenity listings; no mention of bike storage, bike procedures, or cycling-specific services appears anywhere in the content, leaving both required criteria null. Coin laundry, free Wi-Fi, complimentary continental breakfast, and an on-site restaurant are all confirmed from the amenities/services page. Two contact discrepancies exist: the website consistently shows a toll-free number (+1 877-754-8171) vs. OSM's local number (+1-250-754-8171), and the website address is '809 Island Highway South V9R 6Z2' vs. OSM's '809 Trans-Canada Highway V9R 5K1'.
concerns: Phone mismatch: OSM lists local number +1-250-754-8171; website consistently lists toll-free +1-877-754-8171. Used website value.

Address mismatch: OSM has '809 Trans-Canada Highway, V9R 5K1'; website shows '809 Island Highway South, V9R 6Z2'. Street name and postal code both differ — Island Highway and Trans-Canada may be the same road in this section but postal codes diverge. Used website value.
Two different email addresses appear in website footer across pages: info@daysinnnanaimo.com (primary, matches OSM) and info@nanaimohotel.com (appears in some page footers).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel in a strategically useful location between two ferry terminals. A straightforward include for the directory.

Laundry.detail: Coin laundry on site listed under General amenities

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Complimentary cold continental breakfast included with stay, served in the Gabriola Room on the Pool Level; coupon redeemable at on-site Ricky's All Day Grill for a hot breakfast alternative

Nearby evening food.detail: Ricky's All Day Grill on-site with table service and takeout; limited room service also available
